newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CompuCom cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CompuCom cut to hold.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it cut its rating on the shares of CompuCom Systems Inc to hold from buy and lowered earnings estimates on the company after it said late Thursday it expects profit growth to slow.

-- In a statement, Hambrecht & Quist cut its third quarter earnings estimate to $0.10 a share from $0.14 and its fourth quarter estimate to $0.15 a share from $0.18. FY1997 estimate remained unchanged at $0.69.
-- CompuCom said its earnings shortfall is attributable to increased costs, which the investment firm called "a short term issue".
